source.title: [OWNER BRIEF] SourceRating Website 2.0 — unified mobile-first redesign, Intelligence / Kits / Resources / App
source.body:
# SourceRating Website 2.0 — Owner's canonical project-local handoff

**Date:** 2026-10-24 (Asia/Bangkok)  
**Project:** SourceRating Website only; NOT the separate SourceRating application repository.  
**Coordinator:** Existing **sole Claude Lead** (no replacement Lead / parallel release chain).  
**Implementer:** Existing AGY frontend executor, coordinated by Claude Lead; independent Codex / reviewer for QA.  
**Status:** **EXECUTION REQUEST — Preview/independent review authorized; production merge, live payment or personal-data collection remain owner-gated.**

This GitHub issue is the **project-local source of truth for the redesign scope**, not a new task scheduler. Prior GitHub PR comments and Agent Bus notes are historical or supporting references; **do not create a second dispatch or duplicate work because the same instruction exists elsewhere**. If a Lead task is already running, reconcile it and continue the existing task.

## Outcome, not a series of approvals

Deliver a coherent **mobile-first, beautiful and usable professional industrial sourcing destination**, not just an audit or a generic SaaS landing page. Continue Phase 1 findings directly into AGY implementation and independent preview tests. Do not ask the owner whether to fix small defects before wiring the sitemap — coordinate both as routine subtasks.

## Positioning and user journey

**SourceRating — Industrial Sourcing Intelligence & Resources**

A buyer should be able to land on mobile, search by *procurement decision/task*, find trusted technical information, download a genuinely useful resource, explore evidence-based premium research or bilingual tools, and join the separate SourceRating App early-access list when it actually functions.

Five sections, one brand/IA:
1. **Free Resource Library** — official-source task/navigation directory, bilingual Chinese/English task descriptions, publisher + version/rights, usable search/filter, editable **original** download index, no paywall on existing free references. Existing **PR #28** contains 14 source links and a CSV pilot. Do not rehost/sell third-party restricted/copyrighted PDFs, Incoterms texts or proprietary data.
2. **Intelligence** — strong free articles plus differentiated paid investigative/technical procurement research; subscription only after a real verified Gumroad plan, price, delivery/entitlement, tax/refund and account eligibility exists. Avoid fabricated market data, author experiences and empty "premium" summaries.
3. **Field Kits** — buyer-ready, bilingual **English/Chinese** source-verified templates/workbooks with previews, practical worked examples, owner-editable Chinese terminology and original added value. Reuse P01/P02 material and independent review; preserve vetted formulas. Link only **verified** SourceRating Gumroad product URLs; otherwise show honest "in preparation" state, no fake Buy CTA.
4. **SourceRating App / AVP** — **dedicated Coming Soon / Early Access Waitlist** page. Verify if "AVP" was a transcription of "App" or another project term. Do not invent launch date, active membership or real waitlist submissions. A working signup requires approved backend, privacy/consent, deduplication, security and test confirmation; otherwise an honest noninteractive coming-soon is acceptable for Preview.
5. **Professional Services** — preserve original factory audit, supplier verification, engineering procurement and risk-screen paths without dominating research/navigation journeys.

## Existing work; mandatory reconciliation BEFORE coding

- **PR #21** (Draft; head `agent/sr-web-successor-20261016`): research-first homepage, site navigation, explanatory-only `/membership`, sitemap changes. Candidate Vercel Preview recorded READY historically; independent technical/editorial review and real 375/390 mobile visual verification **not completed**. Do not blindly merge.
- **PR #26** (`growth/mobile-cta-20261022`): mobile header CTA; **known mechanically calculated 320px horizontal overflow** (approximately 300px needed vs 288px available). Correct it; confirm with a real viewport, not only a static APPROVE label.
- **PR #28** (Draft; `sr/free-resources-pilot-20261024`): bilingual source navigation and 14-resource CSV. Rights/CBAM preliminary audit passed with caveats; still absent from header nav and sitemap, so direct-URL-only until integrated.
- Keep existing blog articles, permalinks, structured SEO, `/playbook`, `/buyer-decisions`, `/pricing`, `/services`, `/risk-screen`, operating editorial schedule, original GitHub/Vercel owner and existing deployment gates.
- **Avoid three independent merges; one integrated branch and PR after conflict/reuse decisions.** No new parallel lead, owner or article publisher.

## Visual benchmark and implementer split

Before writing new UI, AGY should quickly examine actual examples of:
- Thomasnet — procurement-led discovery/search;
- Supply Chain Dive / World of Procurement — credible editorial hierarchy, legible long-form reading;
- Freightos Learn/Tools — utility information organization.

These are *inspiration, not templates to clone*. At least **two distinct and thoughtful mobile-first directions** for home, resource filters, deep article, paid digital-product page and App waitlist. Design at **320 and 390px first**, then desktop; use selected and reviewed direction for integrated implementation. Favor high-quality typography, restrained brand system, accessible controls, source provenance and realistic data. Do not use generic SaaS gradients or decoratively fabricated engineering proof.

Claude Lead owns requirements, conflict resolution, review assignments and release; AGY owns front-end design/implementation; independent reviewer owns technical, sources/rights and visual acceptance. Do not let "no browser host in one session" stop AGY or other independent tests; document blocked checks honestly while continuing safe work.

## Non-negotiable acceptance

1. One **integrated PR** and correct Vercel Preview URL, commit SHA and design review notes; existing open PRs reconciled (reused/superseded, not blindly merged).
2. Functional navigation, task search/filter, free CSV link, working official source URLs and sitemap. Responsive at **320 / 375 / 390 / 430 / 768 / 1024 / 1440px**, with real viewport screenshots/evidence, especially header overflow.
3. Articles readable on mobile with original sources and non-fabricated graphics. Free content remains useful; paid content clearly differentiated.
4. Clear actual Gumroad status: product URL/price/eligibility/download proof when verified; otherwise disable checkout and specify the one remaining commercial blocker. No invented sales, merchants, or entitlement.
5. App page truthfully Coming Soon; actual waitlist only if user data collection is authorized and function/confirmation/privacy verified.
6. `npm ci`, lint, type/build or available CI, route/link/SEO verification, independent review result, Vercel Preview user-journey tests. No false "PASS" for unexecuted browser work.
7. Final owner checklist: source audit, tests, PR, Preview, remaining unresolved material permissions, and **explicit owner authorization before merge/production/billing**.

## Immediate instruction to Claude Lead

**Phase 1 enough to proceed.** Run parallel subwork: #26 mobile fit, #28 navigation/sitemap, #21 reuse, Gumroad read-only SKU audit, and AGY redesign. Treat these as substeps under the existing project, not competing tasks or choices for the owner.

**This issue is not itself proof of automatic ingestion by an agent.** When Claude Lead picks it up via its normal GitHub polling/project workflow, record an ACK with this issue URL and actual assigned executor / branch / concrete Preview milestones. Do not claim the read or dispatch happened until there is an agent-authored acknowledgement.

References:
- PR #21: https://github.com/Jamescheng2022/sourcerating-website/pull/21
- PR #26: https://github.com/Jamescheng2022/sourcerating-website/pull/26
- PR #28: https://github.com/Jamescheng2022/sourcerating-website/pull/28
- Prior owner execution clarification attached to PR #21: https://github.com/Jamescheng2022/sourcerating-website/pull/21#issuecomment-6378335401

Owner's rule: **No more intermediate "shall I do A or B?"** Make progress autonomously through Preview; bring up only actual payment, personal-data or production release decisions.
